h2: NDT management software: what buyers compare
html:
US and Canadian inspection companies start searching for NDT management software when spreadsheets and a reporting tool are no longer enough. Certificates are tracked in one place, calibration in another, jobs on a whiteboard and invoices in accounting software, and nothing checks one against the other. The category sits between two others: reporting tools produce the NDT report and stop there, while general ERP systems run the business but know nothing about methods, levels or written practices. NDT management software, often sold as an NDT ERP, joins the two.

The workflow it has to carry

Vendors describe the same chain in different words. DRIVE NDT lists order entry, inspection, report generation, approval, billing and archiving; Floodlight's directory listings name dispatch management, equipment tracking, electronic signature and offline access. Whatever the label, NDT workflow management means one record that moves from the client's request to a quotation, to a scheduled job with a qualified crew and calibrated equipment, to a field report captured on site, a reviewed and signed report, a timesheet and an invoice, without anyone re-typing it.

What to check in a demonstration

  • What happens when a technician's certificate for that method and level, or their annual vision examination, has lapsed: does anything warn you before the job?
  • Are instruments, probes and calibration blocks assigned to the job, and is an out-of-date calibration flagged before the crew leaves?
  • Does field capture work offline and sync when the tablet reconnects?
  • Is the report template the method's own, and does the reviewer sign it in the system?
  • Do procedures and approved reports leave an audit trail an auditor can follow?
  • Is the invoice built from the same timesheet that closed the job?

How Atlantis NDT ERP covers it

Atlantis NDT ERP is built on Odoo, so the business apps (CRM, quotations, projects, timesheets, invoicing, purchasing and inventory) are standard, and the NDT layer sits on top. Certification tracking records each technician's scheme, method, level and vision tests, warns before anything expires, and timesheets warn when someone books time without a valid certificate. Equipment and calibration tracking blocks double-booking of a serial number and warns the planner when an assigned instrument is out of calibration. Method-specific NDT reports are captured offline in the field and approved with signatures, and procedures run through a review and approval cycle with locked approved revisions and their history. Because the platform is open, it is configured to your written practice and report formats rather than the other way round.
